fusions.name: Unheard Approach
fusions.desc: Your next weapon strike deals 28 piercing damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your movement speed then rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Spring
fusions.desc: Springs at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at 6 tiles. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Dappled Stillness
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lands Upright
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds. You gain 6% dodge chance.
